review.label: NON_EQUIVALENT
review.rationale: The overlay replaces a conditional check that raises `GlhsInvariantError('snapshot_scope_expired')` when a scope's `valid_until` is non-null and the expiry timestamp is in the past (i.e., the scope has expired) with `if False:`, which is a dead-code branch that can never execute. This means the expiry enforcement is permanently disabled: any call that previously would have raised `GlhsInvariantError` due to an expired snapshot scope will now proceed without error. This produces an observable behavioral difference — expired scopes are no longer rejected, so downstream processing continues where it previously terminated with an exception.
